title: Invertibility of the normalized sectionwise scalar map
statement: For every scheme T, fixed model m, and normalized natural transformation o as above, each component o.app M is an isomorphism.

source.place: Stacks 03EK and 06YY, scalar-extension generators detect isomorphisms

proof.text: Apply internal_section_scalar_adjunction to the coefficient map on T. Only its ordinary restriction and extension isomorphisms, identity-on-sections restriction normalization and Hom-transpose equation are used. Standard derived categories supply its incidental derived hypotheses without changing the fixed SectionModel.

Evaluate the Hom-transpose equation at the identity of the internal scalar extension. Postcompose with restriction of the extension comparison to cancel its inverse. The restriction comparison is identity on sections; hence the extension comparison carries the internal unit to the ordinary sectionwise unit. Compose with the prescribed object equality and apply the ScalarDerivedPair ordinaryUnit equation to obtain a canonical invertible component with exactly the required 1 tensor m formula.

Morphisms out of internal scalar extension are determined by composition with extendUnitHom, by injectivity of the extension/restriction Hom equivalence (Mod.extendScalarsObj_hom_ext'). This remains true after section reconstruction: use its full faithfulness, first transporting an arbitrary target by the counit isomorphism, and then compare the internal preimages on every section.

Postcompose ordinary.app M with the fixed model object equality. Its generator formula agrees with the canonical invertible component from step 2, so step 3 identifies the two morphisms. Cancel the object-equality isomorphism to conclude IsIso (ordinary.app M).

proof_origin.place: lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict and section-tensor-product (Stacks 03EK); ordinary portion of internal_section_scalar_adjunction plus unit-extensionality. The existing unit route is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_section_ordinary_normalized_isIso (T : Scheme.{u})
    (model : SectionModel a T)
    (ordinary : QuotientChange.extension a T ⋙
        (equivalence Λ' T).functor ⟶
      (equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E)
    (hordinary : ∀ (M : Modules Λ T) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (m : M.X.obj.obj W),
      (((ordinary.app M) ≫ eqToHom (model.obj_eq _)).val.app W)
          (((Mod.extendUnit (ProEtale.coefficientMap a T) M).hom.hom.app W) m) =
        (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf (sectionQuotient a T)
            ((equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M)).presheaf).app W
              ((1 : (ring Λ' T).obj.obj W)
                ⊗ₜ[(ring Λ T).obj.obj W,((sectionQuotient a T).hom.app W).hom] m)) :
    ∀ M : Modules Λ T, IsIso (ordinary.app M)
